options.name: Autoplay
options.description: Add autoplay option to the video player. In modern browsers the autoplay functionality doesn't work when player is not muted. Default to true

options.name: Muted
options.description: Player's initial state is muted. Default to true.

options.name: File Types
options.description: Comma-separated list of extensions to process with the plugin as inline media. Default to .mp4,.mov,.avi,.mkv,.mp3

options.name: Background Color
options.description: Player's webpage background color. Can be any CSS-compatible value. Default to #17202A
